turns.reply:
میں نے پاس ورڈ ری سیٹ کرنے کے بارے میں معلومات تلاش کی ہیں، لیکن اس بارے میں کوئی خاص معلومات نہیں ملی۔ آپ اپنے پاس ورڈ کو ری سیٹ کرنے کے لیے درج ذیل طریقے استعمال کر سکتے ہیں:

1. **ویب سائٹ پر پاس ورڈ ری سیٹ کریں**: اگر آپ نے بینک کی ویب سائٹ پر اکاؤنٹ بنایا ہے تو وہاں "پاس ورڈ بھول گئے؟" کا آپشن ہوگا۔ اس پر کلک کریں اور ہدایات پر عمل کریں۔

2. **ہیلپ لائن پر کال کریں**: بینک کی 24 گھنٹے ہیلپ لائن پر کال کریں۔ ایجنٹ آپ کی شناخت کی تصدیق کرنے کے بعد آپ کی مدد کر سکتا ہے۔

3. **برانچ میں جائیں**: اگر آپ کو آن لائن یا فون کے ذریعے مدد نہیں ملتی تو آپ قریبی برانچ میں جا کر مدد حاصل کر سکتے ہیں۔

اگر آپ کو مزید مدد کی ضرورت ہو تو بتائیں!

1. **Monthly Statements**: Generated on the first day of each month, covering the previous calendar month. These statements can be accessed in the mobile app under Documents and can be downloaded as PDF files.

5. **Record Corrections**: If a transaction appears incorrect, you can contact the helpline with the transaction date and amount to raise a dispute within ninety days of the posting date.

# Card Blocking and Replacement

## Block a card immediately
If a card is lost, stolen or used without permission, block it from the mobile app by opening Cards, selecting the card and tapping Block Card. The block takes effect immediately and cannot be reversed by the customer.

## Blocking by phone
Call the 24-hour helpline and choose the card services menu. An agent will verify your CNIC and the last four digits of the card number before blocking it.

## Temporary freeze
A temporary freeze can be lifted by the customer. Use it when you misplace a card temporarily. A permanent block requires a replacement card.

## Replacement cards
Replacement cards are dispatched within three working days to the address on file. Standard replacement costs PKR 500. A replacement after a reported fraud is free.

# Fraud and Security Alerts

## How the bank contacts you
The bank sends security alerts by SMS, email or an in-app notification. A genuine alert never asks for your password, PIN or one-time code, and never asks you to move money to a safe account.

## Suspicious messages
Do not open links in messages that claim your account will be closed. Type the bank address directly into your browser or use the official app instead.

## Reporting fraud
Call the 24-hour helpline immediately if you see a transaction you did not make. Block your card in the app first if the transaction was card-based. A written complaint can be filed at any branch.

## One-time codes
A one-time code is only for signing in or confirming a payment you started. Sharing a code with a caller allows them to take over your session.

## Account monitoring
Enable debit alerts for all amounts. Review your monthly statement even if you receive alerts. The bank is not liable for losses reported more than ninety days after the transaction.

## Fees and exchange rates
The sending fee is PKR 2,500 for transfers up to the equivalent of USD 1,000 and PKR 4,000 above that. The exchange rate shown at the time of confirmation is held for ten minutes.

## Limits
The annual limit for a standard customer is the equivalent of USD 25,000. Business customers can apply for a higher limit with supporting documents.

## Tracking a transfer
A transfer reference number is issued immediately. Use it in the app to see whether the payment is processing, completed or returned. Completed transfers usually arrive within two working days.

## Returns
If the recipient's bank rejects the payment, the amount is credited back to the source account within three working days. The sending fee is not refunded.
